t: Tilting wall mount for 32-55" flat-panel TVs up to 22kg (50lbs). Tilts to reduce glare and reflection. This can be installed in 3 easy steps, attach brackets to TV, attach wall plate to wall and then hang TV on wall plate. Once mounted, TV can shift left or right to be centred on the wall. A quick-release locking system secures TV to wall for added safety.
